title: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)
summary: Thinking Machines Lab: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens — Today we are releasing Inkling 2 Mini, a fast, powerful model that's small enough to run on your laptop.
